Black Specification.*
For a dramatic, purposeful look, the Black
Specification* adds a brooding character to the
Flying Spur. Replacing all exterior polished
chrome with all-black brightware, it includes
side window surrounds, wing vents and lower
door brightware, rear bumper brightware, front
headlamp bezels, radshell matrix, surround and
centre bar, door handles, rear number plate
surround, rear lamp bezels and exhaust outlets.
Styling Specification.
Offering a range of additions in carbon fibre,
the material of choice for the motorsport
industry, the Styling Specification adds to your
car’s dynamic exterior. Elements include a front
splitter, air blades, side sills, rear diffuser and
boot lip.
